title: Structure of the transcriptional co-activator SAGA complex, including the histone acetyltransferase module.
authors: Mattoo, Rayees U H; Chen, Dong-Hua; Bushnell, David A; Tamir, Sagi; Kornberg, Roger D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析SAGA共激活复合物结构，涉及组蛋白乙酰转移酶模块，但核心是蛋白-蛋白复合物组装而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The Spt-Ada-Gcn5 acetyltransferase (SAGA) complex, a 1.8 MDa multi-subunit assembly comprising 19 subunits, is required for RNA polymerase II transcription in eukaryotes. The complex consists of four modules: transcription-associated protein 1 (Tra1), core, deubiquitination (DUB), and histone acetyltransferase (HAT). Although the structures of the Tra1, core, and DUB modules have been determined, the overall architecture of the HAT module remained elusive due to its inherent flexibility. To address this, we conducted cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) analyses on SAGA purified from the thermophilic fungus Chaetomium thermophilum, yielding structures of Tra1 and core modules at 2.6 A and three of the four HAT subunits at 3.7 A. The structure of the HAT module was informative about the aspects of histone acetylation and the interface of HAT-core modules, contradicting earlier AlphaFold predictions. Our structure-guided genetic and biochemical analyses confirmed the roles of Ada1 and Spt7 in anchoring the HAT module within the SAGA complex.
abstract_zh: Spt-Ada-Gcn5乙酰转移酶（SAGA）复合物，一个由19个亚基组成的1.8 MDa多亚基组装体，是真核生物中RNA聚合酶II转录所必需的。该复合物包含四个模块：转录相关蛋白1（Tra1）、核心模块、去泛素化（DUB）模块和组蛋白乙酰转移酶（HAT）模块。尽管Tra1、核心和DUB模块的结构已被解析，但由于其固有的灵活性，HAT模块的整体结构仍不清楚。为解决这一问题，我们对从嗜热真菌Chaetomium thermophilum中纯化的SAGA进行了冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）分析，获得了Tra1和核心模块在2.6 Å分辨率下的结构，以及四个HAT亚基中三个在3.7 Å分辨率下的结构。HAT模块的结构为组蛋白乙酰化及HAT-核心模块界面提供了信息，这与早期的AlphaFold预测相矛盾。我们的结构引导的遗传和生化分析证实了Ada1和Spt7在将HAT模块锚定于SAGA复合物中的作用。
